environment.locale: English app UI observed; exact device locale unavailable
environment.connection: paired wired CoreDevice connection with an active tunnel

preferred_authority.semantics: Xcode Accessibility Inspector when it can select a remote app element

fallback: User-assisted physical-device screenshots, screen recordings, VoiceOver traces, and permission interactions, with only redacted or synthetic fixtures retained
connection_procedure: Connect and unlock the authorized iPhone; keep Nihongo on its Search root
Run `xcrun devicectl list devices` and confirm the expected iPhone is available and paired
Query CoreDevice details, lock state, display state, and the exact Nihongo bundle identifier only
Open iPhone Mirroring; the device owner must perform any Mac-login credential entry
Activate `com.serpentisei.studyjapanese` with CoreDevice without terminating the existing process
Capture the clean Search baseline before any interaction
Use synthetic fixtures and avoid triggering Universal Clipboard until its host payload is explicitly controlled
required_permissions: Mac login entered by the device owner when iPhone Mirroring locks
Camera and Photos permission decisions only when their Search journeys are captured
expected_evidence_outputs: Named human-only procedure when semantics or protected system UI is unavailable
known_limitations: iPhone Mirroring exposes only its macOS shell in the computer-use accessibility tree, not Nihongo's element hierarchy
Xcode Accessibility Inspector detected the physical iPhone target but did not select or return a Nihongo element during the probe
CoreDevice does not expose the current device locale, content-size category, or per-app TCC permission state through the commands used
The physical display reports off while the mirrored display remains visible; later evidence must continue naming iPhone Mirroring as the visual authority
Focusing Search can request Universal Clipboard content; do not permit the transfer unless the Mac clipboard has first been replaced with a synthetic fixture
human_only_steps: Enter the Mac login locally when iPhone Mirroring requests it; never disclose it to the agent
Perform or supervise any VoiceOver trace needed when app-level semantics remain inaccessible
Position the camera at a non-personal synthetic fixture before camera-permission or capture tests
